title: 第3章 白帝城上官家第4章 痛苦的回忆
content_zh:
白帝城城门气派雄伟，城门两边有威武的守城护卫把守，这些护卫正对进出城的行人逐个进行盘查。
这些守城护卫是白帝城城主侍卫队中的成员，负责对白帝城的安全进行防护，以免出现危及城中居民的情况。
白邵阳与张皓旸由于不清楚敌人是谁，为避免暴露行踪，他们进行了简单的改装，白邵阳打扮成一名打柴的普通老者，背着一捆木柴；张皓旸则是将土灰抹到脸上，将头发弄的凌乱不堪紧随其后，外人一看就知是爷孙二人。
二人混在人群中徐徐前行。
白邵阳与张皓旸这种打扮与一般穷苦人家无异，毫无特殊之处，守城护卫只是对他们进行了简单的盘问就放行了。
白邵阳与张皓旸两人进城后迅速向上官家大宅走去。
上官家是白帝城的三大家族之一，论实力与财力均为三大家族之首。
二人来到上官家大宅门口，张皓旸与白邵阳之前多次到过上官家，大部分上官家的人员均认识两人，今天当值的护卫自然也是认识两人的。
当护卫看清眼前两人是白邵阳与张皓旸时，那名护卫立即露出吃惊之色，他让两人稍等，自己则是立即去通报给护卫长。
上官家的护卫长姓李名长风，他的修为乃是元婴境二层圆满，他在上官家是仅次于家主上官远天及部分长老的存在。
元婴境二层圆满的武者不但在白家地位崇高，即便是在白帝城也算数得上的大人物。
获得通报的李长风火速前来，当他看到白邵阳与张皓旸二人时面露惊喜之色，走上前紧紧抱了一下张皓旸，激动的拍了张皓旸后背几下，随后就对张皓旸说了一句：“活着就好！”
然后就立即安排人员将二人领入偏厅，他则是径直穿过正厅飞奔向后厅。
在上官家后厅居中位置的太师椅上，有一位满头白发老者端坐其上，四周有五名老者俯身在其座下。
白发老者身材魁梧，不言自威，面显疲倦之色。
白发老者对众人说道：“大小姐已遇害近半月有余，调查可有进展？皓峰、皓旸可有消息？”
座下五名老者相互对望一眼后纷纷摇头，其中一位老者说道：“家主，事情发生的太过突然，按理说如此大的动作，应该会留下些蛛丝马迹，但是经过近期的调查，我们却是一无所获。”
正中端坐的白发老者正是上官家的家主，上官远天。
上官远天听那位老者的一番话后不禁摇头叹息，满脸悲痛之情，眼中有泪水滴落。
就在此时，李长风急匆匆闯入后厅。

上官远天见到火急火燎赶来的李长风后，立即急声问道：“长风，何事如此失态？”
李长风在环顾四周后直接走到上官远天近前，贴在他耳前耳语道：“家主，皓旸少爷来啦！
属下已经将他们带到偏厅等候。
在敌我不明的情况下，属下未将少爷带到这里。”
闻言，上官远天即便尽量压制激动的情绪，但还是有所表现，他魁梧的身躯有些轻微颤抖，但随即又恢复如常。
上官远天略微平复心情后对左右两旁的五名老者说道：“五位长老，近期多方打探消息，辛苦异常，你们先回去休息吧！”
上官家五位长老向上官远天拱手行礼后便离开后厅。
上官远天则是立即跟随李长风快速向偏厅而去。
张皓旸与白邵阳端坐的偏厅内，没有进行任何交流，只是焦急的等着。
此时偏厅门“嘭”
的一声被推开，上官远天与李长风推门而入。
上官远天在看到张皓旸后，一把将其抱住，眼含热泪的说道：“皓旸我孙，你受苦了！”
此时的张皓旸同样满脸泪水啜泣道：“外公，我的父母没有了，您要为他们报仇啊！”
上官远天一脸慈爱的看着张皓旸，摸着张皓旸的头，无比悲伤的说道：“这仇必须要报！”
上官远天看着面前死而复生的外孙，他满脸悲痛，平时一向威严、庄重的上官家主，此时泪水是止不住的滑落，瞬间就已老泪纵横。
上官远天在得知张家被灭门后，他愤怒异常，发誓要找到凶手，为自己的女儿、女婿、外孙以及张家众人报仇。
上官远天在得到消息后第一时间就安排家族精干人员到安平城对事情进行调查。

content_en:
The gate of Baidi City is majestic, and there are powerful city guards guarding both sides of the gate. These guards are checking pedestrians entering and leaving the city one by one.
These city guards are members of the Baidi City Lord's Guard Team and are responsible for protecting the security of Baidi City to avoid endangering the residents of the city.
Since Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang didn't know who the enemy was, they made simple modifications to avoid exposing their whereabouts. Bai Shaoyang dressed up as an ordinary old man collecting firewood, carrying a bundle of firewood on his back; Zhang Haoyang smeared dirt on his face and made his hair messy followed closely behind. Outsiders could tell at a glance that they were his grandfather and grandson.
The two of them walked slowly forward mixed in the crowd.
Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang were dressed like ordinary poor people. There was nothing special about them. The city guards only briefly interrogated them and let them go.
Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang quickly walked to Shangguan's mansion after entering the city.
The Shangguan family is one of the three major families in Baidi City, ranking first in terms of strength and financial resources.
The two came to the door of Shangguan's mansion. Zhang Haoyang and Bai Shaoyang had been to Shangguan's house many times before. Most of the people in Shangguan's family knew them. Naturally, the guards on duty today also knew them.
When the guard saw clearly that the two people in front of him were Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang, the guard immediately showed surprise. He asked the two to wait while he immediately reported it to the chief of guard.
The chief guard of the Shangguan family is named Li Changfeng. His cultivation level is at the second level of Nascent Soul realm. He is second only to the head of the Shangguan family, Shangguan Yuantian, and some of the elders in the Shangguan family.
A perfect warrior on the second level of Nascent Soul Realm not only has a high status in the Bai family, but is also considered a big shot in Baidi City.
After receiving the notification, Li Changfeng came quickly. When he saw Bai Shaoyang and Zhang Haoyang, he looked surprised. He walked up and hugged Zhang Haoyang tightly, patted Zhang Haoyang's back several times excitedly, and then said to Zhang Haoyang: "It's good to be alive!"
Then they immediately arranged for people to lead the two of them into the side hall, and he ran straight through the main hall and ran to the back hall.
On the Taishi chair in the middle of the back hall of Shangguan's house, there is an old man with white hair sitting on it, surrounded by five old men leaning under his seat.
The white-haired old man was tall and unassuming, with a tired look on his face.
The white-haired old man said to everyone: "It has been nearly half a month since the eldest lady was killed. Is there any progress in the investigation? Is there any news about Haofeng and Haoyang?"
The five old men below looked at each other and shook their heads. One of them said: "Master, this happened too suddenly. Logically speaking, such a big move should leave some clues, but after recent investigations, we have found nothing."
The white-haired old man sitting in the middle is the head of the Shangguan family, Shangguan Yuantian.
Shangguan Yuantian couldn't help but shake his head and sigh after hearing what the old man said. His face was full of grief, and tears fell from his eyes.
At this moment, Li Changfeng hurriedly broke into the back hall.
After Shangguan Yuantian saw Li Changfeng coming in a hurry, he immediately asked anxiously: "Changfeng, why are you so rude?"
After looking around, Li Changfeng walked directly to Shangguan Yuantian, whispered in his ear: "Master, Master Haoyang is here!
The subordinates had already taken them to the side hall to wait.
As the enemy and we were unknown, my subordinates did not bring the young master here. "
Hearing this, Shangguan Yuantian tried his best to suppress his excitement, but he still showed some signs of it. His burly body trembled slightly, but then returned to normal.
After Shangguan Yuantian calmed down a little, he said to the five old men on the left and right: "Five elders, we have been searching for information from many sources recently. It has been extremely hard. You should go back and rest first!"
The five elders of the Shangguan family saluted Shangguan Yuantian and left the back hall.
Shangguan Yuantian immediately followed Li Changfeng and quickly went to the side hall.
In the side hall where Zhang Haoyang and Bai Shaoyang were sitting, they did not have any exchanges, but just waited anxiously.At this time, the side hall door "bang"
With a loud sound, Shangguan Yuantian and Li Changfeng pushed the door open and entered.
After Shangguan Yuantian saw Zhang Haoyang, he hugged him and said with tears in his eyes: "Haoyang, my grandson, you have suffered!"
At this time, Zhang Haoyang also sobbed with tears on his face: "Grandpa, my parents are gone, you have to avenge them!"
Shangguan Yuantian looked at Zhang Haoyang lovingly, touched Zhang Haoyang's head, and said with great sadness: "This revenge must be avenged!"
Shangguan Yuantian looked at the resurrected grandson in front of him. His face was full of grief. The head of the Shangguan family, who was usually majestic and solemn, could not stop his tears from falling. In an instant, he was already in tears.
After Shangguan Yuantian learned that the Zhang family had been wiped out, he was extremely angry and vowed to find the murderer and avenge his daughter, son-in-law, grandson and everyone in the Zhang family.
As soon as Shangguan Yuantian got the news, he arranged for the family's elite personnel to go to Anping City to investigate the matter.
